pages.rationale: Every previously-reported P1 is fixed and verified. Shared ground is now a real inline Select (symmetric pair update on both rows, correct 'count once in Library recurrence' consequence, clears back to dash); timeline markers are focusable buttons that select the row by click and by Enter, and a deep-linked ?event=e2 draws the blue ring + halo on the marker as well as highlighting the row; '+ kind' now stages instead of committing and Discard removes it; channel status is genuinely derived from mark-bad events in both directions (setting e1 to 'exclude, mark channel bad' turns every channel 'bad from 12.5 h'; setting e4 back to 'show on plots' drops CH7_B2 to 'ok / none'); ?state=unsaved now seeds 2 changes with the effect Select amber-outlined. Beyond the regressions, validation is thorough and specific (four distinct time-parse messages, gain, per-channel floor, note required, kind uniqueness/format), every disabled control carries a data-disabled-reason and title, mixed valid+invalid staging disables Save with 'Fix 1 invalid value first', all five recording segments switch both cards, M4_aug is read-only with a banner and a disabled Add event, rows expand, both popovers link back to their event rows, remove/undo works, and in-memory writes survive navigating away and back. No console or page errors in any state. Deductions: 'Reset page to defaults' is enabled after a saved change and does nothing (P1); the CH6_B1 gain field carries no amber outline in ?state=unsaved although the effect Select does (P2); the inline shared-ground Select cannot be dismissed by Escape or an outside click, unlike every other pop on the page (P2); the add-event time error is only a tooltip/disabled-reason while gain and noise floor show inline red messages (P2).

findings.title: 'Reset page to defaults' is a dead click once it is enabled
findings.detail: With nothing changed the button is correctly disabled with data-disabled-reason 'Nothing differs from default'. After staging gain CH6_B1 1.00 -> 0.98 and clicking Save changes, the button becomes enabled - and clicking it does nothing: gain stays 0.98, no toast appears (toasts region empty 250 ms after the click), the button stays enabled, and only 664 bytes of unrelated DOM churn. Every other Settings action either changes state or explains why it cannot. Expected: the page's saved settings revert to canon (gain back to 1.00, the four canon events restored) with a confirming toast.

findings.title: prev fixed: shared-ground chip is a working Select with a symmetric pair update
findings.detail: ground-CH1_A1 now opens ground-select-CH1_A1 (hash ?pop=ground:CH1_A1) listing a dash plus all 15 other channels. Picking CH2_A1 writes CH2_A1 into CH1's cell and CH1_A1 into CH2's cell and stages '2 unsaved changes / CH1_A1 and CH2_A1 count once in Library recurrence on M2_aug fs1'. Clearing CH3_A2 back to the dash gives 'CH3_A2 and CH4_A2 no longer share a ground - both count in Library recurrence'. Verified only.

findings.title: prev fixed: timeline markers select and show the selection ring
findings.detail: marker-e2 is now a transparent rect with role=button and tabindex=0; clicking it sets the hash to ?event=e2 and gives the events-table row class 'clickable hl'. Enter on a focused marker-e3 does the same. In reverse, ?event=e2 draws a blue rounded outline rect plus an r=7.5 halo circle stroked var(--blue) around the e2 marker.

findings.title: prev fixed: a new kind is staged, not committed
findings.detail: Adding 'co2-pulse' now shows '1 unsaved change / co2-pulse joins the event kinds - it can be picked in Add event - no run is marked stale'; Discard removes the chip from the legend. Validation: 'watering' -> 'Kind already exists', 'a' and 'CO2 Pulse' -> 'lowercase letters, digits and -, 2-20, starting with a letter'.

findings.title: prev fixed: channel status is derived from mark-bad events in both directions
findings.detail: On a hard-reloaded clean page, setting the 12.5 h / all-channels event to 'exclude - mark channel bad' stages '1 unsaved change / excluding 12.5 h and marking all channels bad from 12.5 h marks 3 runs on M2_aug fs1 stale' and CH1_A1..CH8_B2 all read 'bad from 12.5 h' immediately; it survives Save and a trip to Vocabulary and back. Conversely, setting the 40.1 h -> end / CH7_B2 event to 'show on plots' stages 'removing the exclusion lets new runs read 40.1 h -> end again - 2 runs marked stale' and drops CH7_B2 to status 'ok' with excluded spans 'none'.

findings.title: prev fixed: ?state=unsaved seeds and counts two changes
findings.detail: A hard reload of ?state=unsaved gives '2 unsaved changes / excluding 31.1-31.5 h on all channels marks 3 runs on M2_aug fs1 stale', gain CH6_B1 = 0.98, effect-e3 = 'exclude span' wrapped in a div.unsaved with computed outline 'rgb(232,144,12) solid 2px'.

findings.title: The CH6_B1 gain field carries no amber outline in the unsaved seed
findings.detail: effect-e3 gets the amber 2 px outline, but gain-CH6_B1's wrapper is a plain 'k-input sm' (computed borderColor rgba(0,0,0,0), outline none, no box-shadow), so the second of the two seeded changes is invisible in the table. Frame 02 outlines the gain cell amber alongside the effect Select.

findings.title: The inline shared-ground Select cannot be dismissed by Escape or an outside click
findings.detail: On ?pop=ground:CH3_A2, pressing Escape and then clicking empty page chrome both leave ground-select-CH3_A2 in the DOM and the hash at ?pop=ground:CH3_A2. The add-event row, the kind popover, the status popover and the spans popover all close on Escape and on an outside click. Picking a value (including the dash) does close it, so the cell is not stuck, but there is no cancel path.

findings.title: The add-event time error is a tooltip only, while gain and noise floor show inline messages
findings.detail: Invalid times give precise reasons ('Write a time like 12.5 h, 28.9 - 29.1 h or 40.1 h -> end', 'Time must be inside 0-721 h', 'The span must end after it starts') but only on the disabled Save row button's title/data-disabled-reason; no red text renders in the row. floor-CH4_A2-error and gain-CH6_B1-error both render visible inline messages, so the page is inconsistent about where it puts validation feedback.
